purpose: pytest coverage for TimeBar rendering, decorator sizing, marker positioning, the compatibility alias for the original misspelled method, zero-duration behavior, and clamping at the movie end.
invariants: TimeBar output length must equal configured length for default, custom, and short bars.
Marker positions are based on rounded internal-length progress and are clamped before the right decorator.
Decorator validation must raise ValueError when decorators plus marker cannot fit in total length.
The original get_marker_postion spelling continues to behave like get_marker_position.
gotchas: Tests intentionally exercise private _empty_timebar because existing behavior treats exact spacing as part of the contract.
